{"metadata":{"description":"DSH Plugin for Markdown like Notion experience","id":"gh:1334281158","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-markdown-ide","slug":"minhdevtry/dsh-markdown-ide","topics":["dsh-plugin","markdown-editor","notion","vscode"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH Plugin for Markdown like Notion experience"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# @anoslide/dsh-vscode-workspace"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> **Unified 3-Column VS Code Workspace, TipTap Notion WYSIWYG Suite, and Advanced AI Productivity Pl"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"ugin for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`).**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## 📖 Overview"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"`@anoslide/dsh-vscode-workspace` is an upstream-aligned, dual-face Cordis plugin for DeepSeek Harnes"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"s. It unifies the entire backend workspace file services and modern IDE frontend into a single packa"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ge, replacing legacy decoupled plugins (`@anoslide/dsh-host-files` and `@anoslide/dsh-client-vscode-"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"cing legacy decoupled plugins (`@anoslide/dsh-host-files` and `@anoslide/dsh-client-vscode-layout`)."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"It combines:
- A **3-Column VS Code IDE Layout** (Explorer, Search, Git Source Control, Multi-Tab Co"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"de & Markdown Workbench, and Collapsible AI Chat & Tool Trajectory).
- A **TipTap Notion WYSIWYG Doc"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ument Suite** (Interactive blocks, slash commands `/`, callout boxes, toggle lists, interactive tabl"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"es, KaTeX math, Mermaid diagrams, and Table of Contents outline).
- **Deep AI Chat Integration** (Au"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"thentic blue reference chips, Cursor-like `Ctrl+K` Inline AI Assist, `@` file mention autocomplete, "},{"id":"p6s6","text":"and 1-click code application).
- **Knowledge & Productivity Tools** (Interactive Knowledge Graph vie"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"w, embedded Excalidraw whiteboards, and visual side-by-side / unified Diff Viewer)."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## 🏛️ Architecture: Dual-Face Cordis Model"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness operates a modular Cordis micro-kernel architecture. `@anoslide/dsh-vscode-workspac"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"e` implements a **Dual-Face** structure where a single package provides both the Node.js host servic"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"es and the browser micro-frontend client bundle."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## 🌟 Key Features"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### 1. 🖥️ Professional 3-Column VS Code IDE Layout
- **Left Sidebar & Rail (280px)**:
- 🐋 **Host Rai"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"l Integration**: Preserves the native `ui-sidebar` controls (New Session, Sessions, Settings) while "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"contributing an interactive switcher via the `sidebar.footer.action` seat.
- 📁 **Explorer (`Ctrl+Shi"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"ft+E`)**: Hierarchical workspace file tree with live Git status badges (`M`, `U`, `A`, `D`, `R`), hi"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"dden files toggle (`👁`), directory creation, and deletion to OS Trash.
- 🔍 **Search (`Ctrl+Shift+F`)"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"**: High-performance recursive workspace search with file-name and full-text content matching (`ripg"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"rep`), case-sensitivity toggle (`Aa`), regex support (`.*`), and match count badges.
- ⑂ **Source Co"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"ntrol (`Ctrl+Shift+G`)**: Stage, unstage, discard, and commit changes with diff previews and commit "},{"id":"p11s9","text":"log history.
- 💬 **Sessions**: Hands the column back to the host's session management at full width."},{"id":"p11s10","text":" Collapsing via `Ctrl+B` hides the panel to the 56px rail without losing navigation.
- **Center Work"},{"id":"p11s11","text":"space (Multi-Tab Workbench)**:
- Independent editor tabs with drag-and-drop reordering, active tab i"},{"id":"p11s12","text":"ndicators, and dirty state badges (`•` unsaved dot).
- High-performance server-side syntax highlight"},{"id":"p11s13","text":"ing powered by **Shiki** (`github-dark` / `github-light`) alongside interactive **CodeMirror** for c"},{"id":"p11s14","text":"ode files.
- **Interactive Breadcrumbs**: Clickable directory hierarchy above the editor for quick p"},{"id":"p11s15","text":"ath navigation.
- **Status Bar**: Live Git branch (`🌿 main`), active file path, line & column indica"},{"id":"p11s16","text":"tors, word counter, UTF-8 encoding, language mode badge, and `💾 Auto-Save: ON/OFF` toggle.
- Tab con"},{"id":"p11s17","text":"text menu (`Close`, `Close Others`, `Close to the Left/Right`, `Close All`, `📋 Copy Path`).
- **Righ"},{"id":"p11s18","text":"t Column (AI Chat & Tool Trajectory)**:
- Seamlessly embedded AI conversation panel and real-time to"},{"id":"p11s19","text":"ol execution stream.
- 1-Click toggle between **Full-Width Editor Canvas** and **3-Column IDE Layout"},{"id":"p11s20","text":"** (`Ctrl+L`).
- Floating **Open Chat** pill button when the panel is collapsed."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### 2. 📝 TipTap Notion WYSIWYG Document Suite
- **Interactive Block Editing**: Markdown files (`.md`"},{"id":"p12s2","text":") render directly into rich, interactive Notion-style blocks.
- **Collapsible Toggle Lists (`/toggle"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"`)**: Foldable summary and details blocks matching Notion's UX.
- **Notion Callouts (`/callout` or `"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"💡`)**: High-visibility callout boxes with custom icons and background tints.
- **Slash Menu (`/`)**:"},{"id":"p12s5","text":" Type `/` to insert Headings (H1/H2/H3), Toggle Lists, Task Lists (`[ ]`), Interactive Tables, Callo"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"ut Boxes, Syntax-highlighted Code Blocks, Blockquotes, KaTeX Math, Mermaid Diagrams, and YouTube emb"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"eds.
- **Interactive Tables**: Add and delete rows and columns dynamically with toggleable header ro"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"ws.
- **Mathematical Equations**: Inline and block KaTeX rendering (`$E=mc^2$` and `$$\int ...$$`).
"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"- **Mermaid Diagrams**: Live rendering of flowcharts, sequence diagrams, and architecture maps insid"},{"id":"p12s10","text":"e notes.
- **Document Outline (`📑 Outline`)**: Slide-out Table of Contents drawer displaying hierarc"},{"id":"p12s11","text":"hical H1, H2, and H3 headings with click-to-scroll navigation.
- **1-Click Export Suite (`📤 Export`)"},{"id":"p12s12","text":"**:
- `📋 Copy Clean Markdown`
- `📋 Copy Formatted HTML`
- `📄 Print / PDF Preview` (`window.print()`)"},{"id":"p12s13","text":"
- **Intelligent Auto-Save Engine**: 1.5-second debounce silently persists document edits to disk wi"},{"id":"p12s14","text":"th subtle `Saved ✓` indicator.
- **Notion Drag Handle**: Hover over blocks to drag and reorder conte"},{"id":"p12s15","text":"nt effortlessly.
- **Floating Selection Bubble Menu**: Highlight text to format: **Bold** (`B`), *It"},{"id":"p12s16","text":"alic* (`I`), Underline (`U`), ~~Strikethrough~~ (`S`), `Inline Code` (`</>`), 🎨 Text & Highlight Col"},{"id":"p12s17","text":"ors, `💬 Mention in Chat`, and `🤖 Ask AI`."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### Prerequisites
- **Node.js**: `v22.0.0` or higher
- **pnpm**: `v9.0.0` or higher
- **DeepSeek Har"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ness (`dsh`)**: Shipped and configured"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## 🔒 Security Sandboxing & Configuration"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The host service enforces sandbox security:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- **Sandbox Root (`DSH_SANDBOX_ROOT`)**: Defaults to `process.cwd()`. All file access, reading, writ"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ing, and deletion are strictly bounded within this directory.
- **Path Traversal Prevention**: Absol"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ute path resolution and realpath verification (`isInsideSandbox`) block directory traversal attacks "},{"id":"p16s4","text":"(`../`).
- **Optional Authentication (`DSH_PASSWORD`)**: When set in the environment, `/vscode-files"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"/*` routes require session-based or token authentication.
- **Cloudflare R2 Integration**: Configure"},{"id":"p16s6","text":" Cloudflare R2 bucket credentials (`R2_ACCOUNT_ID`, `R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`, `R2_"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"BUCKET_NAME`, `R2_PUBLIC_DOMAIN`) for cloud asset storage, or default to local image persistence."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"For comprehensive technical design and API documentation, see Architecture & Technical Specification"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"or comprehensive technical design and API documentation, see Architecture & Technical Specification."}],"truncated":true}
